reasoning_content: Let me test the map/locations and other feature paths. The 404s for /en/profiles and /en/map may just be wrong paths. Let me check actual routes.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rho "path: '[^']*'" config/sync/views.view.*.yml 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo "=== test ==="; for u in /en/locations /en/events /en/magazine /en/glossary /en/archive /en/search; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://openculturas.ddev.site$u"); echo "$u -> $code"; done
